definitions.gloss: advertising expenses; publicity costs; promotion budget
definitions.explanation: Money a company spends on advertising and promoting its products. Appears as a line item in budgets and financial statements.

examples.japanese: {宣伝費|せんでんひ}を{削|けず}った。
{新製品|しんせいひん}の{宣伝費|せんでんひ}に{一億円|いちおくえん}かけるそうだ。
examples.english: I hear they are spending a hundred million yen advertising the new product.

examples.japanese: {売上|うりあげ}が{伸|の}びない{原因|げんいん}は{宣伝費|せんでんひ}の{不足|ふそく}ではないかと{議論|ぎろん}になった。
examples.english: A debate arose over whether insufficient advertising spending was the reason sales were not growing.

notes:
Formed from {宣伝|せんでん} (advertising, publicity) plus the suffix {費|ひ} (expenses), the same suffix as in {交通費|こうつうひ} (travel expenses) and {人件費|じんけんひ} (labor costs).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宣伝費|せんでんひ}をかける: to spend money on advertising
- {宣伝費|せんでんひ}を{削|けず}る: to cut the advertising budget
- {宣伝費|せんでんひ}がかさむ: for advertising costs to mount up
- {年間|ねんかん}{宣伝費|せんでんひ}: annual advertising expenditure

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {広告費|こうこくひ}: advertising expenses — nearly interchangeable, but tied specifically to placed ads; the more common accounting term
- {販促費|はんそくひ}: sales promotion expenses — covers campaigns, samples, and in-store promotion
